about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/build: edits of the Go build action that the package's own tests must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/build (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger").

mutants.name: tc-managed-root-unset
mutants.rule: A managed toolchain's action runs with its own GOROOT and GOTOOLCHAIN=local, whatever the user set.
